tier.description: Crisp X-Crisp-Tier header value for future typed operations.

token_id.description: Crisp token identifier supplied through credential storage, environment, or stdin; never inline in docs or issue text.

token_key.description: Crisp token key supplied through credential storage, environment, or stdin; never inline in docs or issue text.

website_id.description: Optional Crisp website/workspace identifier for future typed commands.

plugin_id.description: Optional Crisp plugin identifier for future typed plugin commands.

start_date.description: Optional RFC3339 lower bound for future incremental streams.

page_size.description: Optional Crisp page-size request value for future paginated operations; provider docs commonly allow 20-50.

max_pages.description: Maximum pages for future typed reads; 0 means unbounded under PM output limits.
